g.aria-label: Three Invariance Identities Pinning Down the Flow Map Φ_{t→s}(x_t)
Two student passes at midpoint r; no derivatives needed
Moving Endpoint s: ∂_s Φ_{t→s}(x_t) = u_s( Φ_{t→s} )
Evaluates velocity u_s at predicted landing point Φ_{t→s}(x_t)
Moving Start t: ∂_t Φ_{t→s} + (∇_x Φ_{t→s}) u_t(x_t) = 0
Evaluates u_t at start x_t via 1 JVP (Consistency & MeanFlow)
With boundary condition Φ_{t→t}(x) = x (ū(x, t, t) = u_t(x)), each identity is exact
